notices.title: City Council Agenda
notices.agenda_text:
CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
Tuesday, September 1, 2026, 6:30 PM
1020 E. Pioneer Rd.
Draper, Utah 84020

AMENDED AGENDA - ADDING ITEM 4.E

6:30 PM STUDY SESSION (ADMINISTRATIVE CONFERENCE ROOM)

        CLOSED MEETING, IF NECESSARY - TO BE ANNOUNCED IN MOTION
        The Draper City Council may temporarily recess the meeting and convene in a closed meeting as provided by UCA § 52-4-205.

        Council/Manager Reports

7:00 PM BUSINESS SESSION

1.	Call to Order

2.	Pledge of Allegiance

3.	Public Comments
To be considerate of everyone attending the meeting, public comments will be restricted to items that are not listed on this or a future agenda and limited to three minutes per person.                                                 Comments which cannot be made within these limits should be submitted in writing to the City Recorder prior to noon the day before the meeting. Comments pertaining to an item on the agenda should not be given at this time but should be held until that item is called.

4.	Consent Items

        4.a  Approve the August 12, 2026 and August 18, 2026 City Council Meeting Minutes

        4.b  Approve Resolution #26-40
        A resolution reappointing Geneva Woodmansee as a member of the Draper City Parks, Trails, and Recreation Committee. Staff: Kellie Challburg.

        4.c  Approve Resolution #26-41
        A resolution appointing Laura Fidler as a regular member of the Draper City Planning Commission. Staff: Kellie Challburg.

        4.d  Approve Resolution #26-42
        A resolution appointing Drew Martinez as an alternate member of the Draper City Planning Commission. Staff: Kellie Challburg.

       4.e  Approve Resolution #26-43
       A resolution authorizing the Mayor to execute a Quit Claim Deed for certain real property located in the Suncrest Development. Staff report by Traci Gundersen.

5.	Items for Council Consideration
 
        5.a Action Item: Approve Ordinance #1737
        An ordinance of the Draper City Council amending Title 3, Chapter 4 of the Draper City Municipal Code regarding Government Records Access and Management. Staff report by Nicole Smedley.

6.	Recess to a Community Reinvestment Agency Meeting

7.	Adjournment

I, the City Recorder of Draper City, certify that copies of this agenda for the Draper City Council meeting to be held September 1, 2026, were posted at Draper City Hall, Draper City website www.draperutah.gov, and the Utah Public Notice website at www.utah.gov/pmn.

Posted this 28th day of August 2026. 
Attest: Nicole Smedley, City Recorder

notices.title: Tree Committee
notices.agenda_text:
TREE COMMITTEE AGENDA

Tuesday, September 1, 2026, 8:00 AM
1020 East Pioneer Road Draper, Utah 84020 
Administration Conference Room

1.	Welcome and Roll Call

2.	Approval of Previous Meeting Minutes 2.a Minutes from May 5, 2026

3.	Wheadon Farm Park Donation

4.	Tree Committee Duties

4.a Plan for Inventory of Existing Trees

4.b Plans for various public areas such as:

Entrances to the city - city council has expressed desire to potentially enlist the Tree committee and allocate budget here

City parks -

     potential planting project for splash pad
     private citizen donor planting for Wheadon Park Main transportation corridors and others

Recommend goals and policies to the city council regarding tree culture for Draper City


4.c Policies for planting of trees for beautification, noise dampening, visual screening, weather protection, erosion control

4.d Recommendations to city council on public relations matters, including, but not limited to Arbor Day, cleanup days, home beautification contests and other tree related city activities

4.e Street Tree Guide
 
4.f  Recommendations to city if desired:

Make recommendations on arboricultural specifications and standards of practices for all trees and shrubbery on City property, and recommend standards and specifications for the work of any person or organization engaged in the business of working on trees within the city

Make recommendations on the grounds immediately surrounding the trees and shrubbery on public property, as far as it is necessary to assure the proper growth, care and protection of said trees and shrubbery

Make recommendations on the care and treatment of trees and shrubbery, including planting, maintenance, pruning, spraying and removal of trees and shrubbery on city property;

Make recommendations on the identification, marking and preservation of historic or notable trees


4.g Develop standards and specifications regarding the planting of trees for new developments, including site plans and subdivisions and make recommendations to the Planning Commission and City Council regarding the same

City planning to adopt the planting standards put forward by city engineering for park strips


4.h Develop standards and specifications regarding the planting of trees on public property, including size, location and approved species and make recommendations for adoption in this code

5.	Adjournment
 
I, the City Recorder of Draper City, certify that copies of this agenda for the Draper Tree Committee meeting to be held September 1, 2026, were posted at Draper City Hall, Draper City website www.draperutah.gov, and the Utah Public Notice website at www.utah.gov/pmn.

Nicole Smedley, CMC, City Recorder Draper City, State of Utah

notices.title: Notice of Public Hearing: City Initiated Town Center Residential Zoning Text Amendment Request
notices.agenda_text:
Posted on August 6, 2026, on the Utah Public Notice Website www.utah.gov/pmn/ Draper City Website www.draperutah.gov/news/ and at Draper City Hall, 1020 E. Pioneer Road, Draper, UT

NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING: City Initiated Town Center Residential Zoning Text Amendment Request

Notice is hereby given that Draper City will hold a public hearing before the City Council to consider the above listed request. The purpose of the request is to amend the text of portions of Chapter 9-11 of the Draper City Municipal Code (DCMC) to permit at least one (1) residential unit on smaller properties in the Town Center zone.

The hearing will be held at Draper City Hall in the City Council Chambers, on August 18, 2026 at 7:00 p.m. The complete notice is posted on the Utah Public Notice Website; www.utah.gov/pmn/, Draper City Website; www.draperutah.gov/news/, and at Draper City Hall. 

To request a copy of the public notice or for additional inquiries contact Todd Taylor at (801) 576-6510 or todd.taylor@draperutah.gov. 

Dated this 6th Day of August, 2026

Attest: Nicole Smedley, City Recorder

notices.title: NOTICE OF PROPOSED TAX INCREASE CITY OF DRAPER SALT LAKE COUNTY
notices.agenda_text:
NOTICE OF PROPOSED TAX INCREASE
CITY OF DRAPER/SALT LAKE COUNTY

The CITY OF DRAPER is proposing to increase its property tax revenue.

The CITY OF DRAPER tax on a $941,000 residence would increase from $466.83 to $583.80, which is $116.97 per year.

The CITY OF DRAPER tax on a $941,000 business would increase from $848.78 to $1,061.45, which is $212.67 per year.

If the proposed budget is approved, CITY OF DRAPER would receive an additional $2,455,712 in property tax revenue per year as a result of the tax increase.  If the proposed budget is approved, CITY OF DRAPER would increase its property tax budgeted revenue by 25.12% above last year's property tax budgeted revenue excluding eligible new growth.  

The CITY OF DRAPER invites all concerned citizens to a public hearing for the purpose of hearing comments regarding the proposed tax increase and to explain the reasons for the proposed tax increase.  You have the option to attend or participate in the public hearing in person or virtually.

Public Hearing

Date/Time: 	8/12/2026 6:00 P.M.
Location: 	Draper City Hall Council Chambers
		        1020 E. Pioneer Rd.
		        Draper, Utah 84020

To obtain more information regarding the tax increase, citizens may contact the CITY OF DRAPER at 801-576-6318 or visit: www.draperutah.gov/city-government/budgets-and-finances/property-tax/

Instructions for virtual participation in the public hearing will be available at Zoom Meeting: https://us06web.zoom.us/j/89466424795?pwd=oubQN9yJKqIlVRl09t72osoTmbqzjm.1
Meeting ID: 894 6642 4795, Passcode: 413389
